title: Lizzie Wilson (Partner, Mishcon de Reya) — 'A brilliant book with powerful lessons for leaders looking to build organisations that stay true to their purpose'
summary: Lizzie Wilson — Partner at Mishcon de Reya (the London firm that hosted the Cambridge and London Incorruptible discussions during the UK tour) — endorses Incorruptible in her post-event reflection.
blockquote: A brilliant book with powerful lessons for leaders looking to build organisations that stay true to their purpose while adapting and growing.
